passive.name: Mental Training
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **20/23/26/29/32%**. For every debuff on the enemy target, the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt against this target additionally increases by **8/9/10/11/12%**, stacking up to **3** times. When using Ultimate to attack the enemy target, the wearer receives the "Disputation" effect, which increases DMG dealt by **36/42/48/54/60%** and enables their Follow-Up ATKs to ignore **24/28/32/36/40%** of the target's DEF. This effect lasts for **2** turns.

passive.name: One At A Time
passive.text: Increase the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%** and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **30/35/40/45/50%**. After the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK, inflicts the target with the "Tame" state, stacking up to **2** time(s). When allies hit enemy targets under the "Tame" state, each "Tame" stack increases the CRIT DMG dealt by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Record
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Chase
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage **50%** or less by an extra **8/10/12/14/16%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Flowers and Butterflies
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. While the wearer is in battle, for every **10** SPD that exceeds 100, increases DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill by **6/7/8/9/10%**. At the same time, increases the CRIT DMG of Ultimate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. This effect can stack up to **6** time(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Mind is Might
entries.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **100%** of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Intellectual Midwifery
entries.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **150%** of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Syllogistic Paradox
entries.text:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **240%** of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target and applies "Wiseman's Folly." When Dr. Ratio's teammates attack a target afflicted with "Wiseman's Folly," Dr. Ratio launches 1 instance of his Talent's Follow-Up ATK against this target.
"Wiseman's Folly" can be triggered for up to **2** times and only affects the most recent target of Dr. Ratio's Ultimate. This trigger count resets after Dr. Ratio's Ultimate is used.

entries.name: Cogito, Ergo Sum
entries.text: When using his Skill, Dr. Ratio has a **40%** fixed chance of launching a Follow-Up ATK against his target for 1 time, dealing Imaginary DMG equal to **270%** of Dr. Ratio's ATK. For each debuff the target enemy has, the fixed chance of launching Follow-Up ATK increases by **20%**. If the target enemy is defeated before the Follow-Up ATK triggers, the Follow-Up ATK will be directed at a single random enemy instead.

entries.name: Mold of Idolatry
entries.text: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that Taunts nearby enemies, lasting for **10** second(s). After entering battle with enemies in this Special Dimension, there is a **100%** base chance to reduce each single enemy target's SPD by **15%** for **2** turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

entries.name: Summation
entries.text: When Dr. Ratio uses his Skill, for every debuff on the target, his CRIT Rate increases by **2.5%** and CRIT DMG by **5%**. This effect can stack up to **6** time(s).

entries.name: Inference
entries.text: When Skill is used to attack an enemy target, there is a **100%** base chance to reduce the attacked enemy target's Effect RES by **10%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Deduction
entries.text: When dealing DMG to a target that has **3** or more debuff(s), for each debuff the target has, the DMG dealt by Dr. Ratio to this target increases by **10%**, up to a maximum increase of **50%**.

entries.name: Pride Comes Before a Fall
entries.text: The maximum stackable count for the Trace "Summation" increases by 4. When a battle begins, immediately obtains 4 stacks of Summation. Needs to unlock Summation first.

entries.name: The Divine Is in the Details
entries.text: When his Talent's Follow-Up ATK hits a target, for every debuff the target has, deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 20% of Dr. Ratio's ATK. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of 4 time(s) during each Follow-Up ATK.

entries.name: Know Thyself
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Ignorance Is Blight
entries.text: When triggering the Talent, additionally regenerates 15 Energy for Dr. Ratio.

entries.name: Sic Itur Ad Astra
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Vincit Omnia Veritas
entries.text: Additionally increases the trigger count for "Wiseman's Folly" by 1. The DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK increases by 50%.

items.name: Past Evils of the Borehole Planet Disaster
